scope: PM15-01 current-session reopen proof ownership and PM15-02 truthful process/evidence health

PM15-01: Each app launch receives a collector-generated evidenceSessionId and a unique ui/session-<index>-<uuid> directory.
The collector launches LWBridge with subprocess.Popen, records the exact launched PID, and reads only ui-session-<that PID>.jsonl from that launch's unique directory.
A current session is healthy only with one matching session-start and session-end for the exact launched PID and no parse/unexpected-file errors.
Search/render correlation is evaluated in event order inside the current session; a correlated render must follow that Search and carry the same requestId.

Reopen requires both session-one and session-two evidence to be independently healthy/current-session Search-render proofs plus same profile and same saved-row signature. Session one cannot satisfy session two.
PM15-02: Windows process observation now returns explicit ok/rows/error/diagnostic state; nonzero exit, malformed JSON, and invalid shapes are UNKNOWN failures rather than empty rows.
A successful empty process query remains distinct and is accepted as an observed empty set.
Preflight blocks when process observation fails and preserves bounded stdout/stderr/exit-code diagnostic in the attempt evidence.
Postflight cleanupClean requires a successful process observation; failed observation can no longer become a clean claim.

Nonzero app exit, malformed/missing current-session UI evidence, failed postflight process observation, failed runtime inspection, or unreadable profile store makes evidenceHealthy false and forces INCOMPLETE before reopen acceptance.
